name: model__prediction__generic__chronos2-small
description: Generic zero-shot time-series forecast model using Chronos-2 small. Reads a parquet with a leading datetime x column and one or more numeric y columns; forecasts the second column, using any further columns as historical multivariate context.

additionalProperty.name: history_length
additionalProperty.description: Number of rows to use as model context. Window ends at total_rows - prediction_offset. Minimum 3. Values above 8192 use only the most recent 8192 rows.

additionalProperty.name: prediction_length
additionalProperty.description: Number of steps to forecast ahead.

additionalProperty.name: prediction_offset
additionalProperty.description: Rows to skip at the end before the history window. Use for back-testing against known data.
